description: The GeoJSON Modelica Translator creates Modelica packages from GeoJSON and system-parameter specifications. Its generated systems can contain building loads, transfer stations, distribution networks and central plants. The provider is URBANopt contributors. Coverage: The software is generic, not a measured geographic dataset. Spatial detail and simulation periods are supplied by the user. Access: The public source repository provides documentation and installation instructions. Source archives and dependencies were not downloaded or run. Licence and cost: The licence permits source and binary redistribution with attribution and a separate URBANopt trademark condition. Included Modelica components carry their own BSD-style terms. Limitations: The README describes uneven feature maturity and a one-way translation. Full simulation requires Modelica Buildings and Docker; these were not installed. For simulation it converts spatial district-system definitions into executable-model structures, with documented fourth- and fifth-generation heating and cooling examples. Related resources: The translator uses results from model-urbanopt-sdk and platform-openstudio. Neither existing description explicitly covers this translator package.
